verdict.rationale: LightSprint claims it can turn Figma designs into working frontend code, which is a form of design-input-to-implementation. It also uses mockups during planning before handing off an implementation task. But nothing shows a developer attaching an arbitrary or marked-up screenshot or image to a task, and the screenshots mentioned are agent-captured review outputs, not inputs. Missing for 10: explicit screenshot/image attachment to tasks, support for annotated or marked-up images, documentation of how visual inputs guide the agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.
